_provenance: Values sourced from outside this project on purpose. If the only evidence a validator were correct came from the generator in synth/, a shared misreading of a specification would be invisible in both. These are published third-party values that this repository did not compute.

aba_routing_valid._source: Published Federal Reserve and commercial bank routing transit numbers.

aba_routing_invalid._source: Single-digit perturbations of the published values above, plus leading pairs outside any assigned Federal Reserve district range.
values: leading pair 13 falls between assigned ranges
leading pair 45 falls between assigned ranges

luhn_valid._source: Standard payment-processor test card numbers, published by Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB and Diners Club for use in test environments. These exercise the validator, not the scanner pattern: JCB and Diners prefixes are deliberately outside the CREDIT_CARD regex.

luhn_invalid._source: Final-digit perturbations of the published test cards above.
values: Visa test number, check digit altered
Mastercard test number, check digit altered
Amex test number, check digit altered
Discover test number, check digit altered

ssn_invalid._source: Ranges the Social Security Administration states have never been issued. Randomisation of assignment in 2011 removed the geographic meaning of the area number but did not retire these exclusions.

ssn_structurally_valid._source: 078-05-1120 is the number printed on the specimen card distributed in wallets by the E. H. Ferree Company in 1938; the SSA has published it as never validly assigned. The remainder are structurally conformant values used here only to exercise the area/group/serial rules.

nanp_invalid._source: North American Numbering Plan administration rules: area code and exchange must each begin 2-9, and N11 codes are reserved as service codes.
values: N11 service code as area code
N11 service code as area code

ein_unassigned_prefixes._source: IRS campus prefix table: these two-digit prefixes have never been assigned to an Employer Identification Number.
